process.title: From first call to launch, in four clear steps

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.body: A free 30-minute call to understand your goals, users and constraints. You leave with honest advice, even if we're not the right fit.

steps.title: Scope and proposal
steps.body: We turn the conversation into a written scope with milestones, a timeline and a fixed quote or package.

steps.title: Design and build
steps.body: Short cycles with working demos. You see progress every week and can change direction early, when it's cheap.

steps.title: Launch and support
steps.body: We launch, monitor and hand over documentation. Ongoing support and improvements are available when you need them.

why.title: One accountable team, built for this region

items.title: One team, full ownership
items.body: Design, development, AI and deployment all in-house. No middlemen and no hand-offs between vendors.

items.title: AI where it pays off
items.body: We add AI where it improves outcomes, with evaluation, safety and cost controls, not as a demo.

items.title: Made for MENA
items.body: Arabic and right-to-left interfaces, local payment integrations and WhatsApp-native workflows.

items.title: Results you can measure
items.body: We agree on the numbers that matter before we build, and report against them after launch.

faq.q: How much does a project cost?
faq.a: It depends on scope. After a free discovery call we send a written proposal with a fixed quote or a package price, so you know the cost before any work starts. Our packages page shows common bundles.

Your proposal includes a timeline with milestones. A marketing website is usually a matter of weeks; web and mobile apps take longer depending on features. We share working demos throughout, so you're never waiting until the end to see progress.
Yes. We build bilingual Arabic and English products with proper right-to-left layouts, Arabic typography and local integrations.

faq.q: Who owns the code and designs?
faq.a: Ownership of custom deliverables is set out in your contract. We document the work and hand it over so your team, or any future team, can maintain it.

faq.q: Can you work with our existing team or system?
faq.a: Yes. We often extend existing products, integrate with tools you already use, or work alongside your in-house developers.

faq.q: Do you offer support after launch?
faq.a: Yes. We monitor launches, fix issues, and offer ongoing improvement and maintenance plans.

custom-software-solutions.title: Custom Software Solutions
custom-software-solutions.summary: Bespoke systems aligned with your workflows, from discovery to long-term support.
custom-software-solutions.body: We design and build software around how your team actually works: integrations, automation and secure deployments that scale with you. You get clear milestones, documented handover and a codebase you can evolve without starting over.

ai-solutions.title: AI Solutions
ai-solutions.summary: Practical AI features: assistants, classification and workflow automation.
ai-solutions.body: We ship AI where it improves outcomes: grounded prompts, evaluation, safety and cost controls. It's integrated with your data and UX, not a demo that falls apart in production.

websites.title: Websites
websites.summary: Fast, accessible marketing sites and product pages that convert and rank.
websites.body: Performance-first builds, SEO-aware structure and content workflows your team can maintain. We pair strong UX with solid technical foundations so your site stays fast after launch.
deliverables: Sitemap, content structure and copy guidance
Responsive design in Arabic and English

web-apps-development.title: Web Apps & Development
web-apps-development.summary: Dashboards, portals and internal tools with robust APIs and clear UX.
web-apps-development.body: Full-stack delivery: authentication, roles, data modelling and integrations. We focus on reliability, observability and maintainability so your web app stays dependable as usage grows.

mobile-apps-development.title: Mobile Apps & Development
mobile-apps-development.summary: Native-quality experiences on iOS and Android with a shared product vision.
mobile-apps-development.body: From MVPs to production releases: offline handling, push notifications, analytics and store readiness. We align mobile patterns with your brand and backend so users get one coherent product.
deliverables: iOS and Android apps from one codebase
App Store and Google Play submission

design-branding.title: Design & Branding
design-branding.summary: Visual systems, UI kits and brand language that stay consistent everywhere.
design-branding.body: We translate positioning into usable design systems (typography, colour, components and motion) so marketing and product teams ship cohesive experiences without constant rework.

video-photography-production.title: Video & Photography Production
video-photography-production.summary: Campaign assets, explainers and product visuals tuned for web and social.
video-photography-production.body: Concept through delivery: storyboards, shoots, editing and export specs for every channel. Assets are produced to match your site and performance budgets.

digital-marketing.title: Digital Marketing
digital-marketing.summary: Acquisition and nurture programmes grounded in measurable outcomes.
digital-marketing.body: We connect analytics, landing pages and messaging tests so you can see what moves the needle, then iterate with clear reporting, not vanity metrics.
deliverables: Paid campaigns on Google and Meta

elevora.title: Every operation. All in one place.
elevora.summary: Elevora is a mobile-first HR and workforce app by Xaeon. It replaces spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and paper timesheets with clock-in, live maps, shifts, tasks, leave, KPIs, hiring and payroll, in English and Arabic.

modules.title: Clock-in
modules.body: Geofenced, one tap. Server timestamps, breaks and overtime prompts you can trust.

modules.title: Live map
modules.body: See field staff in real time and know who is on site.

modules.title: Shifts and tasks
modules.body: Plan rosters by branch and assign daily tasks with progress tracking.

modules.title: KPI scorecards
modules.body: Weighted scorecards and roll-ups for every team and branch.

modules.title: Leave
modules.body: Requests, approvals, balances and a full ledger.

modules.title: Hiring
modules.body: Pipeline, interviews and offers, then one click to add the hire to your roster.

modules.title: Compensation
modules.body: Base, allowances and variable pay with approvals and payroll.

modules.title: Offline first
modules.body: Clock events queue on the phone and sync when the connection returns.

steps.title: Set up your workspace
steps.body: Branches, job roles, shift patterns and work zones, in your brand colours.

steps.title: Import your people
steps.body: Paste or upload a CSV and review incomplete rows before you commit.

steps.title: Run the day
steps.body: Clock-ins, the live map, leave approvals and alerts in one place.

elevora.pricingBody: Plans start from $6 per seat per month, and every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. Enterprise plans with custom limits are available.

faq.a: Yes. Elevora is fully bilingual in English and Arabic.

faq.q: What happens when staff have no signal?
faq.a: Elevora works offline. Clock events queue on the phone and sync automatically when the connection returns.
Start a 14-day free trial with no card needed, or request a demo and we'll walk your team through it.

faq.q: Can Elevora connect to our other tools?
faq.a: Higher plans include integrations such as CMS Goals and HubSpot, plus a REST API and webhooks.

Xaeon Software Solutions ("Xaeon", "we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy describes how we handle information when you visit our website or engage our services.

Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect contact details you submit (name, email, phone, company), messages and files you send when requesting a quote or support, and technical data such as IP address, browser type and approximate location from standard server logs.
We use this information to respond to enquiries and deliver contracted services, to operate, secure and improve our website, and to comply with legal obligations.
We use cookies and similar technologies that are needed for the site to work, such as keeping you signed in to your client dashboard.

With your consent, we also use Google Analytics to understand how visitors find and use the site, and the Meta Pixel to measure our advertising. Until you accept, Google Analytics runs without cookies and the Meta Pixel does not load. You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" link in the footer.

When you send us an enquiry or book a call, we record how you arrived at our site (for example the campaign link, referring website and the first page you visited) with your request, so we know which of our channels are working. You can also control cookies through your browser settings.

We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with trusted processors (for example hosting and email providers) who assist our operations under appropriate agreements, or when required by law.
We retain information only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law. We apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect data.
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or object to certain processing of your personal data. Contact us to make a request.
